label: ASUS Zenbook 14 OLED (UX3405)
description: 14-inch 3K OLED ultrabook, Intel Core Ultra, two Thunderbolt 4 plus USB-A and HDMI, Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: No RJ45 and no Ethernet controller - wired would need a USB-C 1GbE/2.5GbE dongle. Wi-Fi 6E is standard, so model this host with a wireless uplink only.
